title: v9 — strength + power · Mon · Tue · Thu · Fri
rules: Hard cap: 1h15 per session = ≤60 min lifting (warm-up included) + 15 min cardio. Running long → trim accessories, never the power work or the main lift.

Main lifts: 5/3/1 off the Training Max (tm at the top of data.json). Weights round DOWN to 2.5 kg. + = squat and bench top set, weeks 1–3: keep going while reps stay fast, stop with ~2 in reserve, never grind. Log the reps.
TM bump per cycle: week-3 + set ≥3 reps → squat +5, bench +2.5 · 1–2 reps → keep the TM. Deadlift has no + set (back): week-3 single fast and pain-free → +5.
First set last (squat, bench): 3×5 at the first-set weight straight after the main sets, 2 min rest. Skipped on deload.
Power first, never tired: every concentric rep as FAST as possible. A rep, jump or throw that slows or comes up short ends the set. Full rest between jump/throw sets.
⇄ = back-to-back with the line above (superset; on Thursday a contrast pair: lift set → jumps/throws within ~15 s → rest).
Jumps: land quietly and stick it. Week-3 depth jump: step off a 30 cm box, jump the instant you touch down.
Olympic lifts: build to a weight that stays fast and crisp. Log the top weight. All reps crisp → +2.5 kg next cycle.
Arms: LIGHT, once a week (Friday). 2 sets, stop 3+ reps before failure.
Evening (2nd part of the day): pullups / chin-ups only. 2 min warm-up (arm swings, scap pulls, dead hang), every rep chest to bar, stop 3+ reps in reserve. Never to failure.
Rest: main sets 2–3 min · secondary barbell 2 min · accessories 60–90 s · supersets (⇄) 60–75 s per pair.
Cardio closes every session: 15 min bike, easy zone 2 after leg days (least interference with leg power). Tuesday = 8 × 6 s all-out bike sprints, ~90 s easy spin between. Deload week: all easy.
Next cycle: week-3 targets clean → smallest jump (dumbbell +2 kg, barbell/cable +2.5 kg). Re-test (bottom of the page) on day 1 of every cycle.
